ROOT.triggerdef:
Create Trigger CDN.ZamNag_InitFields on CDN.ZamNag for insert as Begin
update T set t.ZaN_ZrdTyp = t.ZAN_GIDTyp, t.ZaN_ZrdFirma = t.ZaN_GIDFirma , t.ZaN_ZrdNumer = t.ZaN_GIDNumer , t.ZaN_ZrdLp = t.ZaN_GIDLp From CDN.ZamNag T join inserted on t.ZaN_GIDTyp = inserted.ZaN_GIDTyp and t.ZaN_GIDNumer = inserted.ZaN_GIDNumer and t.ZaN_GIDLp = inserted.ZaN_GIDLp Where isnull(inserted.ZaN_ZrdTyp,0) = 0 End
